zh: 看板下方出现居中的菜单：添加组件打开悬浮的组件库，按住一行拖到看板可指定落点；整理把卡片按阅读顺序密排；刷新让宿主重读组件库并重挂卡片。
en: A centred menu now sits at the bottom of the board: Add opens a floating library whose rows can be dragged onto a chosen column, Tidy compacts all cards in reading order, and Refresh re-reads the library and remounts the cards.
